newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firms late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firms late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was steady at 9.00-9.50 percent in late trade on Tuesday, unchanged from early morning trade, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was quoted at 6.00-7.00 late on Monday.
"There was nothing exciting today. The market was very quiet as the reserve requirement just passed," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the liquidity was slightly tighter today from yesterday due to further dollar buying and high swap premiums.
The baht was higher to 25.428-25.433 to the dollar from 25.435-25.440 earlier.
"There was more dollar buying than selling today," said one currency dealer. "People were speculating higher dollar demand after foreign investors' selloff in the stock market."
Dealers said buying of the dollar was not so strong as the U.S. unit's weakness against the yen made players reluctant to take dollar positions.
One-month baht/dollar swap premium edged down to 10.30/10.90 satangs per dollar late from 10.75/11.50 early.
The baht/dollar mid-rate was fixed by the Bank of Thailand at 25.43 against 25.45 on Monday.
